note: Quest reward and vendor gem data sourced from the PoE Wiki's Quest Rewards page (https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Quest_Rewards). Skill-gem CHOICE rewards only exist on 11 quests across Acts 1-4 (5 other quests in Acts 5/6/7/9/10 use the same per-class table layout but hand out weapon/armor base types instead, e.g. 'Death and Rebirth' -> body armors — excluded here as out of scope for a gem-only dataset). Vendor stock covers the four class-restricted Act 1-4 vendors (Nessa, Yeena, Clarissa, Petarus and Vanja) plus Siosa and Lilly Roth's class-unrestricted stock, derived as the union of quest-reward gems for their stated act range per the wiki's description of how they work (not scraped from a per-quest-tier table row, which still showed class variation contradicting that description). Vendor stock models each vendor's final, fully-unlocked stock, not gated by which specific quest tier is complete, since the app only tracks zone entry, not quest completion. itemBases and gamblingVendors below remain unverified starter placeholders pending the same treatment.
